import json, platform, sqlite3, sys

source = db.execute("SELECT sqlite_source_id()").fetchone()[0]

Access.name: Emit indexed verification receipts to job log

Development.name: Emit bounded verification receipts to job log
Development.run:
python - <<'PY'
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import textwrap
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("artifacts/ci-profile")
files = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in sorted(root.glob("*"))
         if p.is_file() and (p.suffix in {".json", ".md", ".xml"}
                            or p.name == "selected-tests.txt")}
files["receipt-binding.json"] = (json.dumps({
    "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "tree": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip(),
    "feature_sha": os.environ.get("CI_FEATURE_SHA"),
    "run_id": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
    "run_attempt": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"),
}, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
files["receipt-index.json"] = (json.dumps({
    name: {"bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
    for name, data in files.items()
}, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
output = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for name, data in files.items():
        info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name)
        info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        archive.writestr(info, data)
body = output.getvalue()
if len(body) > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
    raise SystemExit("CI receipts exceed the bounded log limit; use the artifact")
digest = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
print(f"CI_RECEIPTS_BEGIN_V1 {digest} {len(body)}")
for line in textwrap.wrap(base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii"), 120):
    print("CI_RECEIPTS_DATA_V1 " + line)
print("CI_RECEIPTS_END_V1 " + digest)
PY
